```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
```

```{r}
arrow::open_dataset("data/daily_prices.parquet")$schema
```

```{r}
arrow::read_parquet("data/daily_prices.parquet") |>
  dplyr::slice_sample(n = 10) |>
  tibble::as_tibble()
```

```{r}
arrow::open_dataset("data/daily_prices.parquet") |>
  dplyr::filter(date_raw >= "2025-01-01") |>
  dplyr::group_by(coin_id) |>
  dplyr::summarise(avg_market_cap_usd = mean(market_cap_usd, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(avg_market_cap_usd)) |>
  dplyr::collect() |>
  tibble::as_tibble()
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
prices <- arrow::read_parquet("data/daily_prices.parquet")
metadata <- arrow::read_parquet("data/coin_metadata.parquet")
categories <- arrow::read_parquet("data/categories.parquet")
crypto <- prices |>
  dplyr::mutate(date = as.Date(date_raw)) |>
  dplyr::left_join(metadata, by = "coin_id") |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    categories |>
      dplyr::rename(category_description = description),
    by = "category_id"
  )
crypto
```

```{r}
crypto |>
  dplyr::filter(coin_id == "btc") |>
  ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::aes(x = date, y = price_usd)) +
  ggplot2::geom_line(color = "#F7931A", linewidth = 0.6) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 year", date_labels = "%Y") +
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_dollar()) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Bitcoin daily price",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Price (USD)"
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  ggplot2::theme(
    plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank()
  )
```

```{r}
crypto |>
  dplyr::group_by(date, category_name) |>
  dplyr::summarise(category_market_cap_usd = sum(market_cap_usd, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  tidyr::complete(
    date,
    category_name,
    fill = list(category_market_cap_usd = 0)
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(date) |>
  dplyr::mutate(category_share = category_market_cap_usd / sum(category_market_cap_usd)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    category_name = forcats::fct_reorder(category_name, category_share, .fun = mean)
  ) |>
  ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::aes(
    x = date,
    y = category_share,
    fill = category_name,
    group = category_name
  )) +
  ggplot2::geom_area(stat = "identity") +
  ggplot2::annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = as.Date("2022-05-07"),
    xmax = as.Date("2022-05-12"),
    ymin = -Inf,
    ymax = Inf,
    fill = "grey20",
    alpha = 0.18
  ) +
  ggplot2::annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = as.Date("2022-11-08"),
    xmax = as.Date("2022-11-11"),
    ymin = -Inf,
    ymax = Inf,
    fill = "grey20",
    alpha = 0.18
  ) +
  ggplot2::annotate(
    "label",
    x = as.Date("2022-05-09"),
    y = 0.97,
    label = "Luna/UST crash",
    size = 3,
    label.size = 0,
    fill = "white",
    alpha = 0.85
  ) +
  ggplot2::annotate(
    "label",
    x = as.Date("2022-11-09"),
    y = 0.97,
    label = "FTX collapse",
    size = 3,
    label.size = 0,
    fill = "white",
    alpha = 0.85
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "cividis", name = "Category") +
  ggplot2::scale_x_date(date_breaks = "2 years", date_labels = "%Y") +
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::label_percent(),
    limits = c(0, 1),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "How crypto market capitalization is distributed",
    subtitle = "Daily category shares of combined market cap across the 22 tracked coins",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Share of combined market cap",
    caption = "Source: PPBDS tutorial data — daily_prices.parquet, coin_metadata.parquet, and categories.parquet."
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  ggplot2::theme(
    plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.caption = ggplot2::element_text(hjust = 0),
    panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank()
  )
```
